goal: Replace the Sora mock homepage with a verifiable read-only article browsing vertical slice while keeping the Control Plane root entry stable.
completed: Added forum contracts and domain validation for article summaries, details, categories, and query normalization.
Added a filesystem seed repository, application service, and HTTP adapter for GET /forum/articles and GET /forum/articles/:slug.
Extracted Sora into the @harness/web forum feature with loading, error, empty, category, search, and direct article detail states.
Removed Sora localStorage demo authentication, bookmark, follow, and login flows.
Registered Sora business graph metadata and OpenAPI routes.
decisions: Keep / as the Control Plane overview and use /forum plus /forum/articles/:slug for Sora.
Use module-owned filesystem seed data for P1 and keep the repository interface replaceable by PostgreSQL later.
Keep Sora browsing behind the existing Control Plane origin and authorization boundary.
Use one implementation agent because the cross-layer contract and route changes are tightly coupled.
remaining: Commit and push only when explicitly requested.
Identity, bookmarks, follows, replies, and PostgreSQL persistence remain future slices.
risks: GitNexus classifies the server/router diff as medium risk because it touches the existing security/origin execution flow; no HIGH or CRITICAL impact was reported.
Production Sora browsing still inherits the current Control Plane authentication policy; a public unauthenticated deployment would require a separate security decision.
